title: Handle missing values
summary: A missing value means data is absent. isna identifies missing entries; filling them requires a justified choice.
introduction: A missing value means data is absent. isna identifies missing entries; filling them requires a justified choice. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A missing value means data is absent. isna identifies missing entries; filling them requires a justified choice.

blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Asha", "Ben", "Cara"],
    "score": [8, 6, 9],
    "team": ["red", "blue", "red"]
})

values = pd.Series([2.0, None, 6.0])
print(values.isna().tolist())
blocks.title: Handle missing values

blocks.text: The output is [False, True, False]. The middle value is missing.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Count missing values before deciding what to do with them.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not replace every missing value with zero unless zero has the right meaning.
For more detail later, use this [Pandas further reading](https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/getting_started/intro_tutorials/).
